start.title: [TODO:it] Forty Days on Sinai
start.text:
[TODO:it] The cloud has held you for weeks.
Below, the camp grows restless.

choices.text: [TODO:it] Stay and hear every word of God
choices.feedback: [TODO:it] His instruction is not yet finished.

choices.text: [TODO:it] Hurry down before you are ready

haste_consequence.title: [TODO:it] Wait on the Lord
haste_consequence.text:
[TODO:it] His covenant must be received in full.
Return to His voice.

choices.text: [TODO:it] Stay and hear every word of God

people_demand.title: [TODO:it] "Where Is This Moses?"
people_demand.text:
[TODO:it] The people press around Aaron.
"Make us gods to lead the way."

choices.text: [TODO:it] (Aaron) Give in to keep the peace
choices.feedback: [TODO:it] Fear of men silenced fear of God.

choices.text: [TODO:it] (Aaron) Refuse and urge them to wait
[TODO:it] (Aaron) Blame Moses for the delay
choices.feedback: [TODO:it] Blame builds no altar to God.

aaron_yields.title: [TODO:it] Gold from Every Ear
aaron_yields.text:
[TODO:it] Aaron gathers their rings and gold.
A fire is kindled in the camp.

choices.text: [TODO:it] (In vision) See and grieve in spirit
choices.feedback: [TODO:it] The Lord shows you their sin.

god_warns.title: [TODO:it] "Go Down at Once"
god_warns.text:
[TODO:it] "Your people have corrupted themselves.
They worship a calf of gold."

choices.text: [TODO:it] Let His anger consume them
[TODO:it] Plead for Israel before the Lord
[TODO:it] Ask Him to make a new nation of you
choices.feedback: [TODO:it] His promise is not for you alone.

consume_consequence.title: [TODO:it] Stand in the Gap
consume_consequence.text:
[TODO:it] A shepherd does not abandon the flock.
Lift your voice for them.

choices.text: [TODO:it] Plead for Israel before the Lord

self_consequence.title: [TODO:it] Not for Your Name
self_consequence.text:
[TODO:it] His covenant is wider than you.
Pray for the people, not yourself.

choices.text: [TODO:it] Plead for Israel before the Lord
choices.feedback: [TODO:it] His anger relents at your words.

intercede.title: [TODO:it] The Lord Relents
intercede.text:
[TODO:it] His wrath turns from full ruin.
Now take the tablets and descend.

choices.text: [TODO:it] Carry the tablets down to the camp
choices.feedback: [TODO:it] Two stones, written by His finger.

descent.title: [TODO:it] Sound of a Strange Song
descent.text:
[TODO:it] Joshua hears war in the camp.
"No," you say. "It is revelry."

choices.text: [TODO:it] Pretend you did not hear it
[TODO:it] Press on toward the noisy camp

ignore_consequence.title: [TODO:it] Face the Truth
ignore_consequence.text:
[TODO:it] A leader cannot turn away.
Go and see what they have done.

choices.text: [TODO:it] Press on toward the noisy camp

see_idol.title: [TODO:it] The Calf and the Dance
see_idol.text:
[TODO:it] Firelight glints on a golden idol.
The people circle it in song.

choices.text: [TODO:it] Hide the tablets and walk on
choices.feedback: [TODO:it] His law cannot be smuggled past sin.

choices.text: [TODO:it] Throw the tablets down in holy wrath
choices.feedback: [TODO:it] Stone shatters at the foot of Sinai.

choices.text: [TODO:it] Join the circle to learn their hearts
choices.feedback: [TODO:it] Holiness does not bow to idols.

hide_consequence.title: [TODO:it] His Word Demands Response
hide_consequence.text:
[TODO:it] The covenant they broke must be seen.
Let the stones speak truth.

choices.text: [TODO:it] Throw the tablets down in holy wrath

join_consequence.title: [TODO:it] No Compromise with Idols
join_consequence.text:
[TODO:it] Light cannot dance with darkness.
Stand against, not among.

choices.text: [TODO:it] Throw the tablets down in holy wrath
choices.feedback: [TODO:it] Your steps turn toward the altar.

tablets_broken.title: [TODO:it] Silence in the Camp
tablets_broken.text:
[TODO:it] The dancing stops. Eyes drop low.
The calf still gleams on its altar.

choices.text: [TODO:it] Burn it, grind it, scatter the dust
[TODO:it] Leave the calf as a warning
choices.feedback: [TODO:it] An idol left is an idol kept.

leave_consequence.title: [TODO:it] Tear It Down
leave_consequence.text:
[TODO:it] Idols must not be tolerated.
Destroy it without delay.

choices.text: [TODO:it] Burn it, grind it, scatter the dust

aaron_questioned.title: [TODO:it] "What Did They Do to You?"
aaron_questioned.text:
[TODO:it] Aaron stands trembling before you.
"The fire… and out came this calf."

choices.text: [TODO:it] Shrug off the people's great sin
[TODO:it] Call all who are for the Lord to you
choices.feedback: [TODO:it] The Levites step to your side.

choices.text: [TODO:it] Punish only Aaron and spare the rest

shrug_consequence.title: [TODO:it] Holiness Demands Action
shrug_consequence.text:
[TODO:it] A camp unjudged learns nothing.
Call the faithful to stand.

choices.text: [TODO:it] Call all who are for the Lord to you

single_consequence.title: [TODO:it] All Have Sinned
single_consequence.text:
[TODO:it] Aaron alone cannot bear this.
The whole camp must repent.

choices.text: [TODO:it] Call all who are for the Lord to you

repentance.title: [TODO:it] Hearts Bowed Low
repentance.text:
[TODO:it] The camp kneels in dust and tears.
The Lord still walks with His people.

choices.text: [TODO:it] Climb again to plead for forgiveness

ending.title: [TODO:it] Mercy After Wrath
ending.text:
[TODO:it] The covenant bruised but not broken.
Israel walks on, humbled and held.
